scope: Linux ledger revocation and local TLS adapter

validation.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_request_ledger.py tests/test_codex_https.py tests/test_model_upstream.py tests/test_model_channel.py

observations: Persisted revocation is idempotent and prevents a fresh process reserving a request.
Expiry or a changed boot does not prevent revocation or renew the original deadline.
Wrong binding cannot revoke the valid record.
Local TLS streaming stops even when fsync fails; failure is reported and durability is not claimed.
After successful persistence or explicit retry, a replacement adapter is denied before a new connection.
limits: Live supervisor wiring and full recovery are not established.
Other processes already forwarding require independent supervisor shutdown.
No provider-side OAuth revocation is tested.
No storage power-loss or administrator rollback protection is established.
